statistical_interpretation: Reference group: Control missingness rate is 10.93% (106/970).
Significantly lower missingness than Control (diff = -4.62 percentage points, p=0.0051; conservative df=18 p=0.0118). Odds Ratio = 0.549 (45.1% lower odds of missingness).
Significantly higher missingness than Control (diff = +4.92 percentage points, p=0.0038; conservative df=67 p=0.0051). Odds Ratio = 1.534 (53.5% higher odds of missingness).

Marked differential attrition: Home visits missingness is 9.53 percentage points lower than Digital (6.31% vs 15.84%, z = -5.636, p < 1e-5; conservative df=18 p = 2.4e-5). Odds Ratio = 0.358 (64.2% lower odds of missingness in Home visits compared to Digital).
Trial-wide primary outcome missingness is 12.68% (312/2,461). Differential missingness across arms is highly statistically significant (p < 0.001), rejecting Missing Completely at Random (MCAR).
